same_session_control: Only the SSAO camera pipeline is detached/attached. Disabled output equals the frozen rotated-HDR v2 front PNG exactly in all RGB8 pixels. No model or material changes.

runtime_parameters.scope: Screen-space final-image occlusion approximation from actual depth and normals. Parameters are diagnostic choices, not measured material or a radiometric match. Hidden/off-screen visibility, physical indirect lighting and iPhone cost are not qualified.

actual_visual_findings: Crevices and fin overlaps darken in the enabled screenshot.
Bright dotted/irregular edge pixels and noise appear, including upper tabs and cover/fin contours. This is a visible defect; no assertion of physical visibility parity.

The effect is a screen-space postprocess with diagnostic radius15mm, depth bias0.2mm,16samples and textureSamples1. The exact cause of edge defects has not been isolated; aliasing/depth/filter/composition must be examined before adoption.
decision: Rejected for production/game adoption at this stage. Preserve the paired diagnostic; do not expand to the opposite camera before fixing the visible issue. No albedo or source edits to conceal the difference.
next_action: Review postprocess antialiasing, depth-edge validity and composition in a new revision. Recheck the enabled/disabled control, useful cockpit distance and actual device cost before considering adoption. Baked geometric occlusion remains a separate option after UV/LOD qualification.
